title: BelPulse page document
description: Structural contract for a page-builder document (docs/features/block_contract.md, Batch 9). STRUCTURE ONLY. Everything that needs another file to decide -- block type/version against assets/belpulse/blocks/registry.json, indicator and NIS existence against published metadata, grid bounds, grid overlap, duplicate block ids, accessible names, URL and rich-text safety -- is enforced by src/pages/semantics.py so it can carry a specific error code. Numeric grid bounds are deliberately NOT expressed here: JSON Schema's `integer` type accepts 12.0, and a schema `minimum` would report the failure as `schema_violation` instead of `invalid_grid_position`.

schema_version.description: Document format version. src/pages/migrations.py upgrades older versions forward; a newer one is rejected rather than guessed at. No `minimum` here on purpose -- an out-of-range version is reported as `unsupported_schema_version`, not `schema_violation`.

revision.description: Monotonic per-page revision counter. Batch 16's publication transaction owns how it advances.

route.description: Checked against the allowlist in src/pages/semantics.py, not by a pattern here, so a rejection can say which allowlisted shape was expected.

page_type.description: One of homepage, macro, micro, municipality-profile, explorer, data-explorer, map-explorer, blank. Provisional set, per block_contract.md's own open question: it will be reconciled with whatever Batch 15 actually converts. Enforced by src/pages/semantics.py (PAGE_TYPES) rather than by an enum here, so an unknown value is reported as `unknown_page_type`.

theme.description: A named theme, resolved by the renderer (Batch 10) against assets/belpulse/. Deliberately a pattern and not an enum: Batch 9 does not own the theme inventory.

trilingual_text.description: Every user-facing string in a page document (claude.md rule 7). Shape copied from indicator_config.schema.json's `name`.

page_context.description: Template variables a route supplies. Only `nis` exists at schema_version 1 (block_contract.md leaves the wider shape open until Batch 4). `{nis}` is the literal placeholder used by a templated commune route.

allow_overlap.description: Whether two blocks in this section may occupy the same grid cell at the same breakpoint. Absent means false; src/pages/semantics.py reports a violation as `grid_overlap`.

id.description: Unique across the whole document and never reused after deletion, so undo/redo history can name a dead block without colliding with a live one.

version.description: No `minimum` here on purpose -- the registry decides which versions exist, and a bad one is reported as `unsupported_block_version`.

grid_cell.description: Grid units, never pixels: 12 / 8 / 4 columns for desktop / tablet / mobile. Bounds and positivity are checked in src/pages/semantics.py (error code `invalid_grid_position`), because `integer` here would still admit 12.0.

binding.description: A closed vocabulary, not a query language (claude.md rules 20, 21, 23). There is no generic `query` operation -- it is absent, not disabled. `peer` is deliberately absent from `provider` until Peer Model v1 exists (docs/features/data_binding.md's open question); a document naming it fails here rather than being silently ignored. RESOLUTION is Batch 14's: nothing in Batch 9 opens a payload or computes a value.

period_label.description: A period label as the published payloads already write them: YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-Qn.

binding_aggregate.description: `sum` is the ONLY declarable function at schema_version 1, on purpose. Deciding whether a non-additive indicator has a defensible recomputed aggregate is Batch 14's job, using src/analytics/aggregate.py's own answer -- src/pages/ must never restate that decision table (claude.md rule 19, invariant 4).
